answer: Entry-fee ladder: every new wallet pays a registration fee of 50 POA, rising 2 POA for each wallet already created from the same funding source in the past 30 epochs. Ten fakes cost about 680 POA, 1,000 fakes over 100,000, so a gale of clones gets steeply pricier. Fees go to a public pool and any harbor node can audit the ledger. Honest users pay only the base 50 POA, though a fable of shared-office wallets may need an appeal.
